$comment: The source of sf-breadcrumbs's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/breadcrumbs (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

siblings.summary: The crumb's sibling sections ({label, href, current, value}), offered as a menu from a button after the crumb when the host says siblings.

items.x-markup: the attribute takes the list as JSON or the "label::flag,key=value|label" form; without it the sf-breadcrumbs-item children are the list

current.summary: Which crumb is the page. last: the crumb that says current, else the last crumb, unless it says current: false. none: a trail of parents above the page's heading, every crumb with an address a link (owner decision C93 item 4). In sf-header-page's path slot the default is none.

siblings.summary: Offer a crumb's siblings (items[].siblings) as a menu from a button after it (owner decision C93 item 3). Off by default.

expand-label.summary: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show hidden breadcrumbs" in English).

expand-on-ellipsis.summary: Whether a press on «…» opens its hidden crumbs as a menu beside it (C93 item 1). false: the page handles sf-breadcrumbs-press itself.

max-items.summary: A cap on the crumbs shown (3 or more): the start, «…» and the end. 0, the default: no cap; the trail folds only when it has no room for one line.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-breadcrumbs for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split (the old detail from the element's adapter), host-attribute (no shim).

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read for the accessible name; no shim
the old detail adds component, tagName, template and originalEvent, which §8 takes out of the new one: the element's detail adapter makes it
rows.summary: An item was clicked. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable: preventDefault() on an ellipsis item keeps it collapsed. Disabled and current items have the native navigation prevented before dispatch.

x-summary: Shows where the page is in a hierarchy as a list of native links built from items, the items attribute or sf-breadcrumbs-item children. The last crumb is the page unless the items say otherwise or current is none (a trail of parents). A trail that has no room for one line folds its middle into a «…» button whose menu lists the hidden crumbs; on the phone it reads «… › parent › page». Long ancestor names are cut with an ellipsis and a tooltip; a crumb can offer its siblings as a menu (siblings).
x-renamed: settings.items: type string with a list default → list (§4.2)
settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events.sf-breadcrumb-click: "click" is a prototype name (§3.1) → press
events.press: 3 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
events.sf-breadcrumb-click → press: the DOM name is sf-breadcrumbs-press (§8 <tag>-<verb>); the old name is a dated split alias whose detail keeps component, tagName, template and originalEvent
settings.max-items: a number with integer and min (§4.2)
x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0, a minor while sf-breadcrumb-click holds a dated alias (§4.10).
events: a press on a crumb is `press` (click is a prototype name, §3.1), sent as sf-breadcrumbs-press, cancelable: a page that refuses it keeps the ellipsis closed, as it did with the old name.

detail-adapter: §8 takes the element and the browser's event out of detail, so sf-breadcrumbs-press carries {item, index, items}; sf-breadcrumb-click follows once with its old detail (component, tagName, template, originalEvent) through a split row and sfAliasAdapters, sharing one cancel.
key-effects: crumbs are native links and the ellipsis a native button: Tab reaches them, Enter follows a link or opens the hidden crumbs (select). No roving focus.
a11y-name: aria-label on the host, else the language file's runtime word «Хлебные крошки» / «Breadcrumb» (aria-label stays a host attribute, §3.1, alias row host-attribute).

item-shape: items name their fields with `of` (label, href, icon, current, disabled, ellipsis, target, rel, value, aria-label, item-class, container-class, hidden-items); the attribute keeps its JSON and "label::flags|" forms, and sf-breadcrumbs-item children stay the markup form.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus a long trail with the ellipsis, an icon home and children in the markup; probe.json drives Tab and Enter (gate 16).

css-variables: six public variables read by the class sheets (component/breadcrumbs) over the role tokens (§6): the gap, a crumb's colour, a link's colour at rest and on hover, the current crumb's colour and the separator's. They are not in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json yet: that file is shared with the field family's branches.
docs: docs/docs.md, where the folder keeps it (as sf-tooltip).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the scope (§7.7) opens with every placing, also while the trail waits for its items; a trail placed again before its items came kept the scope its removal ended (gate 36).
version 1.1.3: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.5: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (R177, owner decision C93; defects BC-01..BC-11 of control/research/2026-11-12-breadcrumbs.md): BC-01 the page is decided over the whole trail: a crumb's current: false is kept, a one-crumb trail can be a link, and the new setting current="none" (default "last"; "none" in sf-header-page's path) makes a trail of parents with no page. BC-02 opening «…» moves focus to the first crumb it revealed. BC-03 «…» carries aria-expanded="false" and is a square of the 1/3 control height (aria-haspopup comes with the menu of C93 item 1, not with an in-place opening). BC-04 the trail's text is one step under the body on the desktop ladder (14/20) and the body step on the phone ladder and in compact density, never 12; a crumb one presses is 1/3 control height tall (28 desktop, 24 phone and compact). BC-05 a crumb with neither href nor value is text, not a focusable button. BC-06 the trail folds by room: while it takes more than one line one more crumb goes behind «…» (first the middle, then the first crumb: «… › parent › page»); max-items defaults to 0 and stays a cap. BC-07 the class sheet draws the row and the crumbs' boxes itself and the template carries no utility class, so the first paint needs the breadcrumbs and icon sheets and core.css. BC-08 the focus ring has --sf-radius--ui. BC-09 the trail is nav > ol > li, one crumb per entry with its separator. BC-10 no English literal for the name. BC-11 one collapse arithmetic (component/breadcrumbs/js/_trail.js) for this element and the class runtime. Owner decision C93 (all six points, 2026-11-12): (1) «…» opens its hidden crumbs as an sf-menu-context menu (aria-haspopup="menu", the menu owns aria-expanded and gives focus back to «…»), the trail folds only by room; (2) on the phone ladder the trail starts at «… › parent › page»; (3) siblings (boolean, off) with items[].siblings: a button after the crumb opens them as a menu, the current one checked; (4) current="none"; (5) links on-surface-variant, hover and press on-surface with an underline, the page on-surface medium; (6) an ancestor's name is cut at --sf-f2 (12rem) with an ellipsis and its whole text as the tooltip (title), the page wraps. The in-place opening stays as the element's expandEllipsis() only.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-13, a patch; owner decision C93 item 2, navigation intent acceptance on group build 2): on the phone ladder (below lg, 60rem) the trail is one line. The fold already left «… › parent › current», but a long parent (cut at --sf-f2) beside the page's name wrapped to two lines, 52 px at 390. The trail's list is now a grid there, one column per entry, each at most its content and at least nothing, so the room is shared out equally: the shorter of the parent and the page keeps its whole name, the longer is cut with an ellipsis -- the page's own name too, on the phone only -- and the runtime gives a cut crumb its whole name as the tooltip (title), as it did for the ancestors (C93 item 6). «…», the separators and a siblings button keep their size. Measured at 390, 768 (24 px, one line) and 1440 (28 px, one line; the page's name still wraps there when it is longer than the line). Class sheet component.breadcrumbs 1.1.1. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.3 (2026-11-13, a patch; L1 and L2 of the C93 review, decided by the dispatcher under the 2026-10-27 delegation; version 1.2.2 is fix/content-precheck's on integration-fix/content-5): L1 the trail folds by room alone on every ladder (C93 item 1). The phone ladder no longer starts folded: a trail that fits stays whole ("Главная › Раздел", the header-page path, a three-crumb admin trail at 390 and 774), and room hides two crumbs at least, so no single crumb ever hides behind «…» (a three-crumb trail or a two-crumb trail of parents never folds; its names are cut instead). Room is measured, not guessed from a line count: the row is wider than its box, or a crumb is cut narrower than its own cap (an ancestor cut at --sf-breadcrumbs--label-max is cut by design, not by room), or an entry stands below the first (_trail.js trailOverflows, cutByRoom). The fold that gave nothing back (1.2.0 round 2) is gone with what caused it. L2 a line never starts with «›»: the row never wraps; the page's entry takes the rest of the row (flex 1 1 0, at least its longest word) and its name wraps by words there, its first line beside the crumbs (the row stands at its top, each entry a box of the target height); the ancestors shrink and are cut. On the phone C93 item 2 stands: one line, the room shared out, the longer of the parent and the page cut with an ellipsis. Only a trail opened in place (expandEllipsis, every crumb asked for) wraps; the nav says so with data-sf-breadcrumbs-expanded. Class sheet and runtime component.breadcrumbs 1.1.3. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-breadcrumbs to show the current page location in a hierarchy and provide native links to ancestor pages.
do_not: Do not use Breadcrumbs as browsing history, tabs, a menu or a stepper
Do not omit href when an ancestor has a real URL
Do not expose separator icons to assistive technology
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

keyboard: Enter or Space on the ellipsis button
accessibility.focus: Native links and the ellipsis button use keyboard-only focus-visible; the current page and text crumbs do not enter the tab order. Opening the ellipsis moves focus to the first crumb it revealed.

sf-breadcrumb-click.summary: An item was clicked. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable: preventDefault() on an ellipsis item keeps it collapsed. Disabled and current items have the native navigation prevented before dispatch.

items.description: The display items at the time of the click.

getCapturedItems.summary: Reads the captured sf-breadcrumbs-item children into plain item objects (label, href, icon, current, active, disabled, ellipsis, target, rel, itemClass, containerClass, ariaLabel, value, hiddenItems).

getDisplayItems.summary: Returns the items as they are shown: unless the ellipsis is open, the crumbs that fold -- by the max-items cap and by room -- are replaced by one ellipsis item holding them; every item is reindexed and at most one is current.

setState.summary: Writes each key as a host attribute (camelCase to kebab-case): arrays as JSON, true as an empty attribute, false/null/undefined remove it. Returns the element.

onItemClick.summary: Adds a listener for sf-breadcrumbs-press; the handler receives (item, detail, event). Returns the element.

aria-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Breadcrumb" in English).
